svg.title: Euler's Identity — The Unit Circle in the Complex Plane
svg.desc: A diagram showing the unit circle in the complex plane, with e^(iθ) tracing a point at angle θ from the positive real axis. At θ = π, the point lands on −1, giving Euler's Identity e^(iπ) + 1 = 0.
svg.text: e^iπ = cos π + i sin π = −1 + 0 = −1
